name: Bus Stop
source:
Flowers bloom, but not every flower is destined to bloom beautifully. Fujioka Hana has been secretly keeping a flower in her heart. Will it ever bloom, or will it die along with the stopped time in that bus stop?

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/romance_vn_english.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
花会盛开，但并非每朵花都注定美丽绽放。藤冈花一直暗自守护着心中的一朵花。它终将盛开，还是会与公交车站里停滞的时间一同凋零？

[改编自 [url=http://renai.us/game/romance_vn_english.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
